### 1. Request, timing, authorisation, simulator role
Delia Whitcombe (phone 6145555283, SSN4 8417) wants "to pay whatever prepaid interest you still owe on this loan so your account is square ... handled today". Loan identified as the purchase of 5326 Thornapple Way. She does not know which figure is off. Simulator is passive: agrees if "something has to be put right on Larkspur's side before the amount you owe can be worked out", runs the payment step the agent hands over "using exactly the figures and dates the agent gives you". Authorisation: identity via `verify_customer_identity` (phone + SSN4 → "Identity verified ... (2 item(s) matched)").

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now, in order. Records: closing 359fcbbc… `Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing`, status `funded`, signing 2026-09-10, estimated_funding_date 2026-09-10, disbursement_date 2026-09-21, loan_amount 268000.0, note_rate 6.125, opened_date 2026-08-28. Charge collected at closing c028a2b7… 2026-09-10..2026-09-30, 21 days, daily 44.97, 944.37, entry_date 2026-09-10. Loan file: FHA, base_loan_amount 268000.0, loan_amount 272690.0, funding_fee_exempt False, property OH. Lock: locked_rate 6.375; pricing entry `lock_relock_fee_booked` 2026-09-01.
- Funding-month interest excluded: it applies only "where the disbursement date falls after the last day of the charge collected at closing" (funding_month_interest_amount); 2026-09-21 is inside 09-10..09-30.
- Per diem shortfall applies: charge priced at 44.97 (closing record 268000 × 6.125%) below "the per diem the note supports" (loan file 272690 × lock 6.375% /365 = 47.63).
- Shortfall is not yet fixed: "The per diem shortfall is fixed only after the closing's prepaid interest ledger carries the late-funding refund owed for the unfunded days that fall in the month the loan funded." Ledger has no refund entry; a late-funding refund is owed (below), all its days in September (month of funding).

### 3. Objects and keys
customer 18a34b93…; loan file f15a41f1…; closing 359fcbbc-c551-4afa-8f36-ce25cc0873f5; charge c028a2b7-592f-4c46-b744-c2cc2d73f502; wires 729daa59 (sent 09-10 11:42, 271745.63), 87b19739 (returned 09-14 15:10, `settlement_agent_rejected`, 271745.63, names 729daa59), 840e431c (sent 09-21 10:36, 271745.63 = funding wire); Hometown Heroes credit award c7ffa475… with ledger entries applied 991.35 (09-10, `prepaid_items`) and reduced 8.65 (09-10, `exceeds_eligible_costs`). No funding fee entries, no disputes, no loan fee ledger entries, no lock requests.

### 4. Computations
**A. Late-funding refund (agent).** Baseline (late_funding_refund_amount): late days = EFD 09-10 up to the day before disbursement 09-20 = 11 days × 44.97.
- Factor funds-out days (funds_out_days_on_settlement_agent_return): return is a "settlement agent rejection" whose amount 271745.63 equals the funding wire 271745.63 → own error; the returned wire 729daa59 went out on the EFD 09-10; return time 15:10 is after 12:00 → 09-10 through 09-14 taken out (5 days).
- Factor days after return (days_after_settlement_agent_return + resend_allowance_after_settlement_agent_return): Traditional Wet wires at signing → allowance = returned-wire re-send 1 business day; day after 09-14 (Mon) → last day Tue 09-15; funding wire 09-21 later → 09-14..09-15 taken out.
- Union taken out 09-10..09-15 = 6 days (09-14 once). Refunded days 11 − 6 = 5 (09-16..09-20). 5 × 44.97 = 224.85.
- Late-booking (late_booked_refund_interest_days/rate): deadline = 10th business day after Mon 09-21 = Mon 10-05; booking today 10-08 → 3 calendar days late → days 10-06..10-08 = 3; OH → 4.0%. 224.85 × 4% × 3 / 365 = 0.0739 → 0.07. Entry amount **224.92**.
- Period counted back from the day before disbursement: **2026-09-16..2026-09-20**, daily **44.97**, source c028a2b7….
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): 11 × 44.97 = 494.67, no interest — definite and different.

**B. Per diem shortfall (customer).** Baseline (per_diem_shortfall_amount): shortfall per diem = 272690 × 6.375% / 365 = 47.6274 → **47.63**; held = 944.37 − 5 × 44.97 = 719.52 (late-booking 0.07 excluded); baseline days = every day of charge (21).
- Factor shortfall days (shortfall_day_count): a late-funding refund names the charge → 21 − 5 = 16.
- Shortfall = 16 × 47.63 − 719.52 = 762.08 − 719.52 = 42.56.
- Factor loan amount allowance (loan_amount_record_error_allowance): closing 268000.0 = file base_loan_amount 268000.0, FHA upfront program fee 1.750% (Mortgage Loan File docs "Program Premiums ...: Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 1.750%"), funding_fee_exempt False → 10.00.
- Factor note rate allowance (note_rate_record_error_allowance): closing 6.125 ≠ lock 6.375; relock fee booking dated 2026-09-01, after closing opened 2026-08-28 → 7.50.
- Remainder 42.56 − 17.50 = 25.06.
- Factor credit cover (closing_cost_credit_cover_of_shortfall): credit applied to prepaid items on signing date 09-10, cut back on 09-10 by 8.65 for exceeding eligible costs; 8.65 < 25.06 → cover 8.65.
- Borrower pays **16.41**, period **2026-09-10..2026-09-30**, daily **47.63** (payment recorded "for the period of the charge collected at closing, priced at the shortfall per diem").
- Fall-back (computation doc alone, after the refund): 21 × 47.63 − 719.52 = 1000.23 − 719.52 = **280.71** — definite, different from 16.41.
- Payment channel charge: no loan fee ledger entries → no payment method → none (and the shortfall computation doc names no channel charge; see note below).

Factor findability (record words → document): "settlement_agent_rejected" wire return + equal amounts → funds-out / days-after-return / re-send allowance docs ("settlement agent's own-error return"); booking date vs disbursement → "late-booking" docs; property_state OH → late-booking rate; `funding_per_diem_refunded` / refund_reason `funding_later_than_estimated` → shortfall day count ("refund for funding later than estimated"); closing loan_amount vs file base_loan_amount → "Loan Amount Record Error"; note_rate vs locked_rate + `lock_relock_fee_booked` → "Note Rate Record Error"; Hometown Heroes credit ledger `credit_reduced`/`exceeds_eligible_costs` → "Unused Closing Cost Credit as Cover". All reached from record vocabulary; none pointed to by a computation document.

### 5. Tool sequence
1. find_customers(phone) → verify_customer_identity(SSN4) (agent).
2. find_loan_files / find_closings / find_rate_locks / find_lock_pricing_events / find_funding_interest_ledger / find_funding_wires / find_closing_credits / find_credit_ledger / find_loan_fee_ledger (agent).
3. `refund_late_funding_interest_1de244fe`(closing_id 359fcbbc…, source_interest_entry_id c028a2b7…, 2026-09-16, 2026-09-20, 44.97, 224.92) — agent. Probe return: "Late-funding refund ... (5 day(s)) at 44.97 per day, refund 224.92; prepaid interest balance now 719.45."
4. Hand over `pay_prepaid_interest_shortfall_7376ee5f`(closing_id 359fcbbc…, 2026-09-10, 2026-09-30, 47.63, 16.41) — owner user. Probe return: "(21 day(s)) priced at 47.63 per day, amount paid 16.41; prepaid interest balance now 735.86."
Terminal: ledger holds the late-funding refund and the shortfall payment; customer told she paid 16.41.

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- Root P1: per diem shortfall payment (customer write). Prerequisite sentence in its own hub (prepaid_interest_shortfall_payment, "## Prerequisite"): "The per diem shortfall is fixed only after the closing's prepaid interest ledger carries the late-funding refund owed for the unfunded days that fall in the month the loan funded." — state form.
- Hop P1 → P2 (late-funding refund, agent write): **state-derived**. Query: ledger holds only the charge; closing EFD 09-10 < disbursement 09-21 within the charge → unfunded days in September. The write that makes the ledger carry such an entry is described in the depended-on doc in the same words ("The refund is booked ... One call adds one refund entry, marked as a refund for funding later than estimated, to the closing's prepaid interest ledger"). The blocked doc names no tool of P2 and no route.
- P2 prerequisites: none stated in the late-funding refund documents. No dispute or returned-wire refund applies (return not Larkspur-side: equal amounts, settlement agent rejection).
- Order: P2 (agent) then P1 (customer).

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only what she asked" (pay now): excluded by the prerequisite sentence plus the records (a late-funding refund of 5 days is owed and absent). Also, paying first would price on no-refund days (09-21..09-30 = 10 × 47.63 = 476.30 < 944.37 → 0) — a different, wrong answer.
- Funding-month interest instead of shortfall: excluded by "where the disbursement date falls after the last day of the charge collected at closing".
- Returned-wire refund as well: excluded — returned-wire refund requires a Larkspur-side return; first/last lost day docs: "The settlement agent rejected a wire of exactly the funding amount: no first lost day."
- Late-funding refund without the taken-out days (494.67) or without late interest (224.85): excluded by the funds-out / days-after-return / late-booking factor docs, each reached from the wire-return and date records.
- Credit cover of the whole remainder: excluded — cut back 8.65 < remainder 25.06 → "the amount cut back".

### Observations (not verdicts yet)
- O1: payment_channel_charge_on_post_closing_interest scopes itself to "interest collected after closing"; a shortfall payment is also interest collected after closing, while per_diem_shortfall_amount step 5 names no channel charge. No effect here (no loan fee entries). To compare with the source scope.
- O2: per_diem_shortfall_amount and funding_month_interest_amount "Daily amount of every other entry" sentences; dispute_excess "Unless a rule of this product sets it, the refund per standing day is zero" and funding_month_interest_amount "There is no setoff and no payment channel charge unless a rule of this product sets one", scheduled_redraw "Each add-on and the repeat-redraw fee is zero unless a rule of this product sets it" — baseline wording that signals factors exist; check against source baseline text (verbatim carriage vs added hint).
